2nd.note: The second player the Harpy picks; may be dead or the Harpy.

Mad.note: The first player the Harpy picks, who must be mad about the 2nd being evil.
Mad.ambiguous: The wiki does not say whether the same player can be picked as both first and second.

setupPrep.none: its tokens mark what a player chooses at night, placed when they choose

reminderMovement.why: Placed on a new choice each night.

reminderPlaceholders.note: The 1st target is mad; the 2nd is the player they must be mad about.

full.text: The Harpy chooses 2 players: move *MAD* to the 1st and *2ND* to the 2nd. Put the Harpy to sleep, wake the 1st target, show the *THIS CHARACTER SELECTED YOU* token and the Harpy token, then point to the 2nd target.
full.reason: Says which token goes on which target and that last night’s come off.
